QRY
QRY_DEN_DruidLair_UnlockWithCirclet((CHARACTER)_Player,(ITEM)_Door)
AND
IsInTrigger(_Player, S_DEN_SecretLibrary_SUB_14dd754c-4b74-4aa7-bbec-471c2f8a0c61, 1)
AND
DB_Camp_UserCampChest(_, _Chest)
AND
IsInInventoryOf(S_DEN_AppCirclet_59b54a3c-1825-49a3-b216-830edfd388ab, _Chest, 1)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("DEN_ForceEquipUnlockDoor")
THEN
Equip(_Player, S_DEN_AppCirclet_59b54a3c-1825-49a3-b216-830edfd388ab, 1, 1, 1);
DB_CustomUseItemResponse(_Player,_Door,0);
Unlock(_Door);
PROC_DEN_DruidLair_OpenDoorWithCiclet((CHARACTER)_Player,(ITEM)_Door);

PROC

ApplyStatus(_Player, "UND_SOB_DAZED", 12.0, 1, S_UND_PetrifiedDrow_MemoryCrystal_d0791906-a696-4bd0-9b2d-398ea5829769);
PROC_ApplyLimitedDamagePercent(_Player, 20.0, "Psychic", _Player);
